'''Rules of Acquisition''' is the 19th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 1 December 1999. The set consists of 130 cards.

This set introduces the Ferengi affiliation in a 130-card set that transforms the Star Trek CCG tournament scene because it includes potent antidotes to decks built around Black Hole, Q-Bypass, bonus points, Computer Crash, Anti-Time Anomaly, Red Alert, Rogue Borg Mercenaries, Visit Cochrane Memorial, and more.

This set is available in 9-card booster packs. There are 30 booster packs in one booster box.

[[Decipher]] issued a double-sided Rules Supplement and a Card List sheet inserted in each booster box.

This set is noted for the following:
* Introduced the Ferengi affiliation as a playable affiliation
* Introduced the first concept of in-game currency and gambling

==Additional Information==
*'''Rules of Acquisition''' was printed on 121 card sheets by TBC, USA.
*Every rarity had its own print sheet.
*The Common print sheet had 6 copies of Gold-Pressed Latinum, 2 copies of Emergency Evacuation and Incoming Message - Ferengi, and 3 copies of the 37 other common cards for a total of 121 cards (11x11 format).
*The Uncommon print sheet had 4 copies of 33rd Rule of Acquisition and 3 copies of the other 39 uncommon cards for a total of 121 cards (11x11 format).
*The Rare print sheet had 2 copies of all rare cards plus 1 extra copy of 21 cards (Continuing Committee, Tower of Commerce, Chula: The Door, Orion Syndicate Bomb, Kukalaka, Breen CRM114, Sceptre of the Grand Nagus, Jovis, Orb of Wisdom, Phased Cloaking Devive, Starry Night, Quark's Bar, Lemec, Bractor, Krayton, Kreechta, Lurin, Omag, Protection Racket, Quark's Isolinear Rods, and Writ of Accountability) for a total of 121 cards (11x11 format).
